setlist.title: It Must Have Been The Roses

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bertha** (1 review): Reviewer ranks this Bertha among the best performances of the song they have heard [6]
- **Dire Wolf** (1 review): Reviewer counts this Dire Wolf among the best versions of the song they have heard [6]
- **It Must Have Been The Roses** (1 other source): A 2:18 stretch of crowd noise and tuning was patched in between Brown Eyed Women and Music Never Stopped [3]
- **The Music Never Stopped** (1 review): The jam keeps building endlessly, with off-the-charts energy unlike other versions the reviewer has heard, though not necessarily the best ever [13]
- **Friend Of The Devil** (1 review): Slower-paced Friend Of The Devil changes the song's character; its build-up gives a tragic feel [17]
- **Playin' In The Band** (1 review): Terrapin Station into Playin' is great, especially the Playin'; the first set is called forgettable [14]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): The first Wharf Rat solo is described as wildly out there; second set gets spacey and intense [10]

## The recordings

- **gd78-01-15.sbd-aud.citsman.13252.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 16 songs; 141 min; rated 4/5 by 8 [1]. Said about its sound: Sound quality is mediocre but acceptable to the reviewer; The board source sounds merely average, though Jerry's guitar tone comes across as perfect; Sound is well below par, and the second set comes from an audience-only source [6][7][13]
- **gd1978-01-15.fob.holwein.motb-0132.106182.flac16**: source not stated; 16 songs; 141 min; rated 3.71/5 by 7 [2]. Said about its sound: Recording is a newer seed; headphones make the listener feel present at the show; Recording's sound quality is somewhat low, though Jerry's thin, frail voice is audible and enjoyed; Good-quality audience recording, though the levels could be higher [10][12][14]
- **gd1978-01-15.167749.sbd.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac2496**: soundboard; 9 songs; 63 min [3]
- **gd1978-01-15.aud.augments-citsman.80954.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 2 songs; 13 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]

## Around the show

- January shows broke from the band's usual touring schedule, something they had not done since 1970, per an attendee's blog [15]
- Jerry's voice was marred by laryngitis on this tour, and shows were full of Bobby-only songs [15]
- Bob Weir quipped that someone nearby had just declared nuclear war [17]
- Places this show within the January/February 1978 stretch of Dead shows, which the reviewer finds smokin' [7]
- Reviewer finds this Music Never Stopped jam stronger than any other version they know [13]
- Friend Of The Devil left second sets afterward, returning as a second-set opener at Foxboro 7/2/89 [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd78-01-15.sbd-aud.citsman.13252.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard and Audience composite [1]. Also: Mixed source: set 1 soundboard through low-count analog generations; set 2 audience recording copied through several formats to SHN; Credits Hanno Bunjes and Chuck Kiefe, with final edits and encoding by JCotsman [1]
- **gd1978-01-15.fob.holwein.motb-0132.106182.flac16**: taped by Reinhart Holwein; transferred by Bob Menke and Derek McCabe; source: 2 x AKG D224E >> Sony TC-158SD >> MAC [2]
- **gd1978-01-15.167749.sbd.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac2496**: taped by From the collection of Doug Lamarre; transferred by Matt Vernon, SirMick; source: Soundboard Cassette (4th gen) - from the collection of Doug Lamarre [3]
- **gd1978-01-15.aud.augments-citsman.80954.sbeok.flac16**: source: AUD>MC>C>D>CD>EAC>SHN [5]. Also: Same source as shnid 13252, with soundboard for set 1 and audience for set 2; this completes the circulating audience material [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by lostlivedead.blogspot.com: [January 15, 1978: Selland Arena, Fresno, CA (January 1978 Tour Itinerary)](https://lostlivedead.blogspot.com/2012/04/january-15-1978-selland-arena-fresno-ca.html) [19]
- Poster by Worthpoint: [1977 Rare Grateful Dead Poster Selland Arena Fresno 13" X 23" | #1925390221](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/1977-grateful-dead-poster-selland-1925390221) [20]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Selland Arena - January 15, 1978](https://www.dead.net/show/january-15-1978) [21]
